observations.behavior: Replacement of GitHub secret reference with GitHub repository variable reference for GitHub App token client-id. This changes the credential lookup mechanism from an organization secret to a repository variable, which is a prerequisite for the workflow to use the GitHub App token without requiring the secret to be shared with forked repositories.
observations.posthog_connection: This workflow configuration enables GitHub Actions workflows to authenticate using a GitHub App token. The PostHog team uses GitHub Apps for automation. This hunk changes the credential lookup, but without the corresponding repository variable definition and the workflow execution, the benefit is not demonstrated. No score.
